key_idea: Take away the road to Sara's house to find the two other parts of the road.
steps: Ben to Sara is 15 km. The last 6 km is from the crossing to Sara. So Ben to the crossing is 15 - 6 = 9 km.
Sara to Leo is 18 km. Again 6 km of that is from Sara to the crossing. So the crossing to Leo is 18 - 6 = 12 km.
Ben to Leo goes from Ben to the crossing, then to Leo: 9 + 12 = 21 km.

choice_feedback.A: 12 km is only the road from the crossing to Leo.
choice_feedback.B: 15 km is the road from Ben to Sara, not to Leo.
choice_feedback.C: 18 km is the road from Sara to Leo, not from Ben.
choice_feedback.E: That is too long. Ben to Leo is 9 km and then 12 km.
